alienblood:
Alien blood is a craftable fluid. 

Like all fluids, it can only be held in the Inventory in a liquid container, such as a Temporary bottle or a Canteen.
alcohol:
Alcohol is a non-craftable fluid.

Alcohol is typically used to disinfect wounds. It is also a crafting material.
disinfectant:
Antiseptic is a craftable fluid.

Antiseptic is typically used to disinfect wounds. It's often the go-to option, as it's fairly cheap to craft.
antirad:
Anti-rad is a non-craftable fluid.

It is used to treat Radiation sickness.
amiodarone:
Amiodarone is a non-craftable fluid.

It can be used to treat fibrillation, at the cost of muscle health.
antiserum:
Antiserum is a non-craftable fluid.

Antiserum is an antibiotic, typically used to treat Infection and Sepsis.
applejuice: Apple juice is a non-craftable fluid that is typically used to increase Hydration and Mood.
antivenom:
Antivenom is a craftable fluid. 

Like all fluids, it can only be held in the Inventory in a liquid container, such as a Temporary bottle or a Canteen.
biochem:
Bio-chem is a craftable fluid.

Bio-chem is by far the most used fluid in crafting.
bleach:
Bleach is a non-craftable fluid.

Bleach is typically used to disinfect wounds. It is also a crafting material.
blood:
The liquid that flows through the player character's veins.

Blood is typically used to restore blood volume. It is also a crafting material.
braingrow:
Braingrow is a non-craftable fluid. 

Braingrow is typically used to treat brain damage. It is also a crafting material.

Like all fluids, it can only be held in the Inventory in a fluid container, such as a Temporary bottle or a Canteen.
ceftriaxone: Ceftriaxone is a non-craftable fluid. It is an antibiotic that increases your immunity, which helps with Infections.
carbonatedwater: Carbonated water is a non-craftable fluid that is typically used to satisfy thirst and increase mood.
chloroform:
Chloroform is a non-craftable fluid.

Chloroform can be used to induce unconsciousness.
cereal:
Cereal mix is a craftable fluid.

The liquid itself cannot be crafted directly; you must craft Bowl of cereal which contains the Cereal mix liquid.
chocolatemilk: Chocolate milk is a non-craftable fluid that satisfies Thirst and boosts Mood at the cost of causing Sickness.
water:
Clean water is a craftable fluid. It can also be found in various fluid containers.

It is typically used to satisfy thirst.
coffee:
Coffee is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used to restore Energy, but this comes at cost of Sickness.
dirtywater:
Dirty Water is a tile fluid.

It primarily exists to punish bad hygiene, but can also be used in recipes for its water quality.
epinephrine:
Epinephrine is a non-craftable fluid.

It increases adrenaline and treats cardiac arrest, but can also cause fibrillation if overused.
energydrink:
Energy drink is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used to restore Energy at cost of a lot of Sickness.
fentanyl:
Fentanyl is a craftable fluid. 

It is an opiate, typically used for crafting or trading due to its extremely high weight efficiency. While it can be used as a painkiller, great care must be taken in its application to avoid a deadly overdose.
fat:
Fat is a craftable fluid.

It can also be crafted into Soap (liquid), Soup (liquid), and Pemmican.
heroin:
Heroin is a non-craftable fluid. 

Heroin is an opiate, typically used to treat pain. However, being a moderately potent opioid, even small injections can quickly cause overdose.
midgradestimulant:
Hard stimulant is a non-craftable fluid.

It is a drug that provides powerful buffs to endurance, mobility and offense. When used irresponsibly it can cause a crash or even overdose.

Stimulants are typically used in life-threatening scenarios to enable escape or aid in combat.
groundwater:
Groundwater is a tile fluid that naturally appears in all layers.

It can be used to satisfy Thirst at the cost of minor Sickness, as well as loss of Mood.

It is primarily used to craft Clean water, but is also usable in recipes requiring water crafting quality.
icetea:
Iced tea is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used to increase Hydration and Mood, but this comes at the cost of some Sickness.
hotsauce:
Hot sauce is a non-craftable fluid.

It can be used to increase your body temperature, but it also satisfies some Hunger and Thirst.
icecream:
Ice cream is a non-craftable fluid.

It can be used to decrease your body temperature, but it also satisfies some Hunger and Thirst.
lrdserum:
L.R.D. Serum is a craftable fluid. 

It is a special fluid that is only effective when used with the L.R.D. or Makeshift L.R.D.
keratinbooster: Keratin-booster is a non-craftable fluid that is typically used to treat Dulled claws.
ketchup:
Ketchup is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used for its Condiment crafting quality, to craft Burger.
urine:
Lemonade is a non-craftable fluid. 

It is typically used to increase Hydration and Mood.
lumalgae:
Lumalgae is a tile fluid.

It is highly buoyant and pushes entities upward, including the player. This makes it very difficult to swim downward in it.

Groundwater that comes in contact with Lumalgae turns into Lumalgae.
localanesthetic: Local anesthetic is a non-craftable fluid used to treat pain.
highgradestimulant:
Medical-grade stimulant is a non-craftable fluid.

It is a drug that provides powerful buffs to endurance, mobility and offense. When used irresponsibly it can cause a crash or even overdose.

Stimulants are typically used in life-threatening scenarios to enable escape or aid in combat.
milk:
"Milk" could refer to:
• Milk carton
• Milk (liquid)
• Powdered milk (liquid)
• Milky
mercury:
Mercury is a non-craftable fluid.

It is most notable for being (almost) completely useless.
naloxone:
Naloxone is a non-craftable fluid. 

It is one of the two opiate antagonist fluids in the game, the other being Naltrexone.
morphine:
Morphine is a craftable fluid.

It is typically used to treat Pain.
mindwipe:
Mindwipe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 30 mL of Mindwipe and 30 mL of Morphine.

It can be used as a last-resort life-saving measure.
mold:
Mold is a non-craftable fluid.

It is most notable for being (almost) completely useless.
naltrexone:
Naltrexone is a craftable fluid. 

It is used to treat sickness and opiate abuse.

It is one of the two opiate antagonist fluids in the game, the other being Naloxone.
lowgradestimulant:
Off-brand stimulant is a non-craftable fluid.

It is a drug that provides powerful buffs to endurance, mobility and offense. When used irresponsibly it can cause a crash or even overdose.

Stimulants are typically used in life-threatening scenarios to enable escape or aid in combat.
oxyline: Oxyline is an non-craftable fluid that is primarily used to treat low blood oxygen.
opium:
Opium is a craftable fluid.

It is typically used to treat Pain.
orangejuice:
Orange juice is a non-craftable fluid. 

It is typically used to increase Hydration and decrease  Sickness, but this comes at the cost of Happiness.
oliveoil:
Olive oil is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used for its Fat Crafting quality.
oil: Oil is a tile fluid. It obstructs the player's movement.
painkillers:
Painkillers is a craftable fluid. 

Painkillers is an Opiate, typically used to treat pain.

Like all fluids, it can only be held in the Inventory in a fluid container, such as a Temporary bottle or a Canteen.
procoagulant: Procoagulant is a craftable fluid. It treats Bleeding and Stroke.
powderedmilk:
Powdered milk is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically used to craft Milk.
producejuice:
Produce juice is a craftable fluid. 

It is typically used to satisfy thirst and increase mood.

It can also be crafted into Refined juice.
redblood:
Red blood is a non-craftable fluid.

It is most commonly used to unlock Bio-terminals, enabling access to valuable loot.
refinedjuice:
Refined juice is a craftable fluid. 

It is typically used to satisfy thirst and increase mood.
reliefcream: Relief cream is a craftable fluid.
ringersolution:
Ringer's solution is a non-craftable fluid.

It is a blood equivalent, used to treat blood loss and thirst.
redsludge:
Red sludge is a tile fluid released by Pus sacks when destroyed.

It provides some Thirst and Hunger at the cost of major Sickness.
saline:
Saline is a craftable Fluid.

It can be used to treat Blood loss, thick blood and thirst.
soap:
Soap is a craftable fluid.

It removes Dirtiness from the character. It can be used to disinfect wounds, but not very well.
sodiumnitroprusside:
Sodium nitroprusside is a non-craftable fluid.

It lowers Blood pressure when injected.
soda:
Soda is a non-craftable fluid. 

It is typically used to increase Hydration, Energy and Mood but this comes at the cost of Sickness.
soup:
Soup is a craftable fluid. 

Like all fluids, it can only be held in the Inventory in a fluid container, such as a Temporary bottle or a Canteen.
sportsdrink:
Sports drink is a non-craftable fluid.

It increases Energy and greatly increases Hydration, but gives a small amount of Sickness.
streptokinase:
Streptokinase is a non-craftable fluid.

It is a blood thinner, typically used to treat pulmonary embolism and reduce blood viscosity.
sap:
Tree sap is a tile fluid that only generates in the 5th layer.

It satisfies Thirst and Hunger at the cost of minor Sickness.
vasopressin: Vasopressin is a non-craftable fluid. It raises Blood pressure when injected or ingested.
woundglue:
Wound glue is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 80mL of Wound glue.

It can be used to disinfect wounds and treat bleeding, skin damage, muscle damage, and pain.
yogurt:
Yogurt is a non-craftable fluid.

It is typically eaten as a decent source of Satiation
